name: Field Group Metadata
description: Groups metadata fields to the right side to have a clean content editing experience.
project_description:
This module allows you to create a metadata field group, provided by the Field Group module, which can hold all your meta information about a content. This group will then automatically be moved to the advanced section of your content edit form, leaving the way open to view your primary content only, and having the meta information out of the way, but still prominently concentrated.

 Back to top 

 How does it work? 
 Absolutely simple!

 
 Install the module first 
 Navigate to the "Edit form display" page of your desired content type 
 Click on "Add group" to add a new field group 
 Select the group type "Details" 
 Give your group a label. Ensure that the machine name is group_metadata ! 
 Save and continue. Configure your group as you like
